request: In the watchlist, show movies I haven't watched yet before the ones I've watched.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked
requests.reason: With the required unwatched-first ordering, clicking Movie 1's checkbox marks it watched, which immediately moves it behind the still-unwatched Movie 2. The original position-based assertion `checkbox()` therefore reads Movie 2's unchecked checkbox and fails regardless of implementation. I changed only that lookup to find Movie 1's checkbox by its aria-label, so the test still asserts exactly the same behaviour (the clicked movie's checkbox becomes checked). All other assertions in the test are untouched.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when blank space on the row is clicked
requests.reason: Same unavoidable consequence of the new ordering: clicking Movie 1's row marks it watched, moving it to the end of the list, so `checkbox()` (first item) no longer refers to Movie 1 and its `checked` would be false. The assertion now looks up Movie 1's checkbox by its aria-label; the row-click toggle behaviour being tested is unchanged.
